prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1008; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you were involved in in Houston, Texas. Before we begin, do you consent to this conversation being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by the claimant on file, if that's okay.

Q: That's acceptable. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in the city, waiting to turn. I had been stopped for maybe ten or fifteen seconds when I felt a hard jolt from behind.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No. I was looking ahead at the light. The first thing I noticed was the impact and the sound of metal.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?

A: Yes, it was drivable, but the rear bumper was pushed in and the trunk wouldn't close properly.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed whiplash and told me to expect stiffness in my neck and upper back for several weeks.

Q: How are you feeling today?

A: My neck still aches, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spot. I've also had headaches a few times a week, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed two days and had to shift some of my duties to a coworker while I recover.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm following the treatment plan and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
